options.name: -f
options.description: Targeted local node database file path

options.name: -raw
options.description: Don't strip off prefix from DirectoryService API constants

options.name: -plist
options.description: Print out record(s) or attribute(s) in XML plist format

options.name: -url
options.description: Print record attribute values in URL-style encoding

name: readall
-readall
subcommands.description: Prints all the records of a given type

name: readpli
-readpli
subcommands.description: Prints the contents of plist_path for the plist at value_index of the key

name: list
-list
ls
-ls
subcommands.description: Lists the subdirectories of the given directory

name: search
-search
subcommands.description: Searches for records that match a pattern

name: createpl
-createpl
subcommands.description: Creates a string, or array of strings at plist_path

name: createpli
-createpli
subcommands.description: Creates a string, or array of strings at plist_path for the plist at value_index of the key

name: append
-append
subcommands.description: Appends one or more values to a property in a given record

name: merge
-merge
subcommands.description: Appends one or more values to a property in a given directory if the property does not already have those values

name: delete
-delete
rm
-rm
subcommands.description: Delete a directory, property, or value

name: deletepl
-deletepl
subcommands.description: Deletes a value in a plist

name: deletepli
-deletepli
subcommands.description: Deletes a value for the plist at value_index of the key

name: change
-change
subcommands.description: Replaces the given old value in the list of values of the given key with the new value in the specified record

name: changei
-changei
subcommands.description: Replaces the value at the given index in the list of values of the given key with the new value in the specified record

name: diff
-diff
subcommands.description: Compares the data from path1 and path2 looking at the specified keys (or all if no keys are specified)

name: passwd
-passwd
subcommands.description: Changes the password of a user
